tests.title: Web POS takes 20% off when the cart exceeds the promo code threshold
tests.goal: Verify the discount amount on a qualifying basket.
preconditions: An active 20% promo code advertised for spending above HKD 50 applies to the selected store. Eligible products are available.
data: Use eligible items with no competing discount, or turn off unrelated basket offers for the cart.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Open Web POS for a participating store.
Enter the promo code and click Apply.
Clear the test cart without checking out.

expected.text: The named offer deducts HKD 20 and the cart total is HKD 80.

notes: HKD 100 subtotal, abovexcode HKD 20 discount, HKD 80 total.

tests.title: Web POS enforces the advertised cutoff for an above-threshold promo code
tests.goal: Verify that an offer advertised as above HKD 50 does not discount a basket that is at or below HKD 50.
preconditions: An active 20% promo code advertised for spending above HKD 50 applies to the selected store. Eligible products are available.
data: Use eligible items with no competing discount, or turn off unrelated basket offers for the cart.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Open Web POS for a participating store.
Add eligible items totaling HKD 49 and apply the code.
Remove the code and replace the basket with HKD 50 of eligible items.
Enter and apply the code again.
Clear the test cart without checking out.

expected.text: The code does not discount the HKD 49 basket.
The code does not discount the HKD 50 basket under the advertised wording.

notes: HKD 49 no discount but code marked Applied. HKD 50 received HKD 10 despite above HKD 50 wording. See Q-025.
